gloss: the underworld; the realm of the dead; Hades

definitions.gloss: the underworld; the realm of the dead; the afterlife
definitions.explanation: The world of the dead in Buddhist and Japanese folk belief. The place where souls go after death.

examples.english: To depart on the journey to the underworld.

examples.japanese: {冥土|めいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I heard a good story — something to take with me to the grave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{冥土|めいど}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}える→会う：00482_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother joked that she looked forward to meeting grandfather in the afterlife.

notes:
A Buddhist-derived concept referring to the dark underworld where the dead reside. Also written as {冥途|めいど}. The word appears frequently in set expressions and idioms.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {冥土|めいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧: a story or experience to "take to the grave" — something memorable heard or experienced late in life
- {冥土|めいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: the journey to the afterlife — dying
- {冥土|めいど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅立|たびだ}つ→旅立つ：12951_tabidatsu⟧: to depart for the afterlife — a euphemism for dying

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あの{世|よ}→あの世：10214_anoyo⟧: the other world; the afterlife — the most common everyday term
- {黄泉|よみ}: the land of the dead — from Shinto mythology; archaic and literary
- ⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧: hell — a place of punishment, unlike {冥土|めいど} which is neutral
- ⟦{浄土|じょうど}→浄土：13447_joudo⟧: Pure Land — the Buddhist paradise, a positive afterlife destination

USAGE:
Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦メイド→メイド：12377_meido⟧ (maid), which is a loanword from English.
